h1: WE Hotel Riverfront — the most restful choice for recovery near Yanhee Hospital Bangkok
intro: Down a small soi off Charan Sanitwong Road in Bang O, tucked right against the Chao Phraya, you find a hotel that feels nothing like central Bangkok — WE Hotel Riverfront, a 4-star adults-only property with a saltwater outdoor pool, a lush riverside garden and the You & I restaurant looking out over the water. It sits 1.1 km from Yanhee International Hospital, roughly a 7-minute drive, making it the most restful option in the Yanhee cluster for post-surgery recovery. Rates start from approx. THB 1,500/night at quieter times and reach around THB 4,300 at peak. The hotel scores 9.1 from 175 Trip.com reviews, with cleanliness at 9.6 and service at 9.4.

body.html: WE Hotel Riverfront sits in a quiet soi on the Chao Phraya in Bang O–Bang Phlat — the first thing almost every review mentions is how different the atmosphere is from any other Bangkok hotel. With just 38 rooms in a 5-floor building, adults-only policy and a location pressed right up against the river, the hotel has a mood closer to a countryside resort than a city property. Trip.com's 175 reviews give it a 9.1 overall, led by cleanliness at 9.6 and service at 9.4 — numbers that reflect genuine care, not just marketing.

Rooms run from the WE Superior Room (around 25 sqm) up to the WE Penthouse Suite at the top. All come with air-conditioning, Smart TV, rainfall shower, blackout curtains and free Wi-Fi. The Riverview rooms look out over the Chao Phraya and the Rama VII Bridge — multiple reviews call the early-morning light on the water a highlight of the whole stay. Some categories include a separate sitting area, which is a genuine comfort when you need to spend a day or two resting after a procedure.

"The room was spotless, so calm, with beautiful river views. The staff were kind and helpful from the moment we arrived. It felt like escaping the city completely — remarkable value for what you get."

The feature guests write about most is the outdoor saltwater pool facing the river — peaceful in the morning, beautiful at dusk, and an unusually pleasant place to sit even if you're not swimming. The surrounding garden is densely planted with native trees and flowers, giving the whole property a green, shaded feel that aids rest. The You & I Restaurant & Bar runs breakfast and dinner; reviews single out the barista-crafted latte art at breakfast as a small but memorable touch.

For anyone recovering from surgery at Yanhee: the hospital is 1.1 km away, about a 7-minute taxi ride. The hotel has no dedicated hospital shuttle, but taxis and Grab cars are easy to call from the lobby; the hotel's staff are happy to help. Free on-site parking makes it convenient for companions who drive. The silence and garden setting here are genuine recovery assets — light, greenery and rest are hard to find this close to the hospital at this price.

Honesty matters here. The location is down a narrow soi — every review that mentions the setting also notes that you need a taxi or Grab for every errand or meal outside the hotel. MRT Bang O is 1.5 km away; walkers should not expect to reach it on foot after surgery. Some reviews also note mosquitoes in the outdoor areas at dusk, a predictable reality of a lush riverside garden. Pack repellent. A handful of guests also mention that the Wi-Fi code must be re-entered daily, a small irritant for longer stays.

Tips from reading through the reviews: book a Riverview room if you're staying more than two nights — the price difference is small and sunrise on the Chao Phraya makes mornings noticeably better during a recovery. Send the hotel's GPS coordinates to your taxi driver in advance, as the narrow entrance to the soi trips up some navigation apps. And bring mosquito spray if you plan to make use of the garden at sunset — the outdoor areas are lovely when you're protected.

honestSummary: WE Hotel Riverfront is at its best for anyone who needs a calm, clean riverside retreat for post-surgery recovery near Yanhee — not a sightseeing base. Cleanliness and service are outstanding, the pool and garden are genuinely restful, and the 9.1 score reflects real guest satisfaction. Accept that you need a taxi for everything outside the hotel, and pack mosquito repellent for evenings in the garden.
honestChecks: If you want to walk to restaurants, shops or the MRT — the hotel is in a quiet soi with nothing walkable nearby and MRT Bang O is 1.5 km away → for a location you can walk from, look at H-Banaat, which is 100 m from Yanhee itself.
If you are bothered by mosquitoes — the riverside garden at dusk has them, as you'd expect on a lush riverbank → bring repellent and the outdoor areas become a pleasure rather than a problem.
If you need a room with a kitchen — there is no kitchen here, and the restaurant keeps set hours → for a kitchenette or in-room cooking facilities, look at BeWish Residence nearby.

tips.title: Getting to Yanhee is easier than it looks
tips.body: The 1.1 km to Yanhee takes about 7–10 minutes by taxi or Grab and costs roughly THB 50–80. The staff will call one for you. Free parking is available if a companion is driving.

tips.title: Give your driver the GPS pin
tips.body: The hotel entrance is down a narrow soi that some navigation apps get wrong. Share the Google Maps pin or say 'Soi Charan Sanitwong 96/2' clearly before setting off — it saves confusion on arrival.

tips.title: Bring mosquito repellent for evenings
tips.body: The garden and riverside terrace at dusk are beautiful — but a lush riverbank means mosquitoes. A can of OFF or similar turns an annoyance into a non-issue and lets you enjoy the outdoor space fully.

tips.title: Book a river-view room for a longer stay
tips.body: Riverview rooms cost a little more but sunrise on the Chao Phraya and the evening light over the water make every morning and evening noticeably better — well worth it for a three-night-or-more recovery stay.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — WE Hotel Riverfront Bangkok

faq.q: Where is WE Hotel Riverfront and how far is it from Yanhee Hospital?
faq.a: WE Hotel Riverfront is at 218/1-3 Soi Charan Sanitwong 96/2, Bang O, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700. It is 1.1 km from Yanhee International Hospital, approximately a 7-minute drive by taxi or Grab. MRT Bang O is about 1.5 km away. There is no hotel shuttle to the hospital, but staff will call a taxi for you on request.

faq.q: Is WE Hotel Riverfront suitable for post-surgery recovery at Yanhee?
faq.a: It is one of the best options in the area for a restful recovery. Key advantages for patients: exceptional cleanliness (9.6/10), warm and attentive service (9.4/10), a very quiet environment, riverside garden and free parking for companions. Things to note: no kitchen in rooms, the restaurant has set hours, and you need a taxi to reach the hospital (7 min, approx. THB 50–80 per trip).

faq.q: What are the room types and prices at WE Hotel Riverfront?
faq.a: Rooms start from approx. THB 1,500/night at off-peak times and reach around THB 4,000–4,300 during busy periods. Options include: WE Superior Room (~25 sqm), WE Superior Riverview Room (Chao Phraya view), WE Premier Corner Room (~30 sqm), and the WE Penthouse Suite (largest). A Riverview room is strongly recommended for stays of two nights or more.

faq.q: What facilities does WE Hotel Riverfront have?
faq.a: The hotel offers an outdoor saltwater pool with river views, a lush garden and riverside terrace, the You & I Restaurant & Bar serving breakfast and dinner, free Wi-Fi, and free on-site parking. It is an adults-only property. There is no gym or airport shuttle.

faq.q: How do I get from the airport to WE Hotel Riverfront?
faq.a: From Suvarnabhumi Airport: a taxi or Grab takes around 45–60 minutes and costs roughly THB 350–450 including expressway tolls. From Don Mueang: about 45–60 minutes and THB 250–350. Always share the hotel's GPS pin or say 'Soi Charan Sanitwong 96/2' to your driver, as the soi entrance is narrow and some navigation apps take the wrong route.
